description_en: Creates a flow control rule by calling the CreateFlowRule operation
description_zh: 调用CreateFlowRule接口创建流控规则
kebab_example: aliyun ahas-openapi create-flow-rule --namespace default --app-name ahas-demo --relation-strategy 0 --threshold 50.0 --resource handleServiceA --control-behavior 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateFlowRule

parameters.help_en: The application name. If the application is an EDAS application, set AppName to the App ID in EDAS. You can view the corresponding ID on the Application Management > Basic Information page in the EDAS console
parameters.help_zh: 应用名，若为EDAS应用，则AppName为EDAS中的App ID，可在EDAS控制台“应用管理>基本信息”中查看对应的ID
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The statistical dimension. Valid values: 0: current interface. 1: associated interface. 2: chain entrance
parameters.help_zh: 统计维度。0表示当前接口，1表示关联接口，2表示链路入口
parameters.name: relation_strategy

parameters.help_en: The threshold of the flow control rule. The value must be an integer greater than or equal to 0
parameters.help_zh: 流控规则的阈值，取值范围为≥0的整数
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the rule. Default value: false
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en: The resource name. The value cannot exceed 1024 characters and must correspond to the resource name on the interface details page
parameters.help_zh: 资源名。不能超过1024个字符，且该资源名需要与接口详情页面的资源名称相对应
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en: The source application. Default value: default
parameters.name: limit_origin

parameters.help_en: The associated interface name or entrance resource name. This parameter is required when RelationStrategy is set to 1 (associated interface) or 2 (chain entrance)
parameters.help_zh: 关联接口名、入口资源名。当统计维度relationStrategy值为1（关联接口）或2（链路入口）时，需要设置该字段
parameters.name: ref_resource

parameters.help_en: The flow control effect. Valid values: 0: fast failure. 1: warm-up. 2: queuing
parameters.help_zh: 流控效果。0表示快速失败，1表示预热启动，2表示排队等待
parameters.name: control_behavior

parameters.help_en: The warm-up period, in seconds. This parameter is required when ControlBehavior is set to 1 (warm-up)
parameters.help_zh: 预热时间，单位秒。当controlBehavior值为1（预热启动）时，需要设置该字段
parameters.name: warm_up_period_sec

parameters.help_en: The timeout period, in milliseconds. This parameter is required when ControlBehavior is set to 2 (queuing)
parameters.help_zh: 超时时间，单位毫秒。当controlBehavior值为2（排队等待）时，需要设置该字段
parameters.name: max_queueing_time_ms

parameters.help_en: The threshold mode for flow control
parameters.name: threshold_mode

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success

AppName.description_en: The application name. If the application is an EDAS application, set AppName to the App ID in EDAS. You can view the corresponding ID on the Application Management > Basic Information page in the EDAS console
AppName.description_zh: 应用名，若为EDAS应用，则AppName为EDAS中的App ID，可在EDAS控制台“应用管理>基本信息”中查看对应的ID

ClusterEstimatedMaxQps.description_en: The estimated maximum QPS for the cluster interface

ClusterFallbackStrategy.description_en: The fallback strategy when cluster flow control communication fails. Valid values: 0: fallback to standalone. 1: pass directly
ClusterFallbackStrategy.description_zh: 集群流控通信失败退化策略，0表示退化到单机，1表示直接通过

ClusterFallbackThreshold.description_en: The fallback threshold for standalone mode. This parameter is returned when the fallback strategy is set to fallback to standalone (ClusterFallbackStrategy=0)
ClusterFallbackThreshold.description_zh: 退化单机阈值，当退化策略为退化到单机（ClusterFallbackStrategy=0）时返回

ClusterMode.description_en: Indicates whether cluster mode is enabled

ClusterThresholdType.description_en: The threshold mode. Valid values: 0: standalone average threshold. 1: cluster threshold
ClusterThresholdType.description_zh: 阈值模式，0表示单机均摊阈值，1表示集群阈值

ControlBehavior.description_en: The flow control effect. Valid values: 0: fast failure. 1: warm-up. 2: queuing
ControlBehavior.description_zh: 流控效果。0表示快速失败，1表示预热启动，2表示排队等待

Enable.description_en: Indicates whether the rule is enabled

RefResource.description_en: The associated interface name or entrance resource name
RefResource.description_zh: 关联接口名、入口资源名

Resource.description_en: The resource name. The value cannot exceed 1024 characters and must correspond to the resource name on the interface details page
Resource.description_zh: 资源名。不能超过1024个字符，且该资源名需要与接口详情页面的资源名称相对应

StatDurationMs.description_en: The statistical window duration in cluster mode, in milliseconds
StatDurationMs.description_zh: 集群模式下统计窗口时长，单位为毫秒

Threshold.description_en: The threshold of the flow control rule. The value must be an integer greater than or equal to 0
Threshold.description_zh: 流控规则的阈值，取值范围为≥0的整数

ThresholdMode.description_en: The threshold mode for flow control

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
